subject: mutate blocks some data types... Feature or?

messages.author: e3fc8587db796618
messages.subject: mutate blocks some data types... Feature or?
parts:
In general I've found a few cases like the folloeing where dplyr:mutate isn't as general as plyr:mutate.  I'm curious if that's planned?

does not work:
mutate(data.frame(Year="2014",Month="5"), DT=strptime(paste0(Year,"/",Month,"/1"),"%Y/%m/%d"))

does work:
mutate(data.frame(Year="2014",Month="5"), DT=as.Date(strptime(paste0(Year,"/",Month,"/1"),"%Y/%m/%d")))
plyr::mutate(data.frame(Year="2014",Month="5"), DT=strptime(paste0(Year,"/",Month,"/1"),"%Y/%m/%d"))

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: mutate blocks some data types... Feature or?
parts:
dplyr prevents you from putting POSIXlt vectors into a data frame -
this is actually a very good idea, since they don't work very well.

Hadley
